Hello! That's correct. The FDIC (Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation) insures deposits up to $250,000 per depositor in each insured bank, for each account ownership category. This includes Helix Bank. 

To ensure your savings are fully protected, you can spread your funds across different ownership categories, such as single accounts, joint accounts, or trust accounts, if applicable. 

If you have more than $250,000 in deposits, consider how you can distribute the funds among these categories to maximize coverage. For detailed guidance specific to your situation, I recommend reviewing the FDIC's coverage rules or contacting our secure customer service line at 1-800-HELIX-CS or using the Helix Bank mobile app for more personalized advice.<|im_end|>
